name: Dejan Petrović
bio: Dejan's culinary journey began in his grandmother's kitchen in Belgrade, where he learned the art of traditional Serbian cuisine. He transitioned from fine dining to motorsport catering after a chance encounter with a racing team owner at a food festival. Dejan believes a well-fed team is a winning team, and he meticulously plans menus to optimize energy levels and morale. His insistence on fresh, locally-sourced ingredients and his signature 'Pljeskavica Power Bowls' have become a team favorite.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A stocky man with a warm smile and a powerful handshake.

quirks: Insists on tasting every dish before it leaves the kitchen.
Has a lucky spatula he refuses to let anyone else use.
Always plays traditional Serbian folk music while prepping meals.
